openClinicalQuestions: Which antiemetic categories, if any, should be named after clinical review?
What local maternity route should patients use after hours?
Which dehydration indicators should be retained in final triage copy?

claimLedger.claim: Pregnancy nausea can occur at any time, and small frequent intake may help some people.
claimLedger.limitations: Supportive strategies are not a substitute for assessment when intake is poor.

claimLedger.claim: Persistent vomiting with dehydration or inability to keep fluids down needs medical advice.
claimLedger.limitations: Urgency depends on severity and clinical context.
